description: Northeast feasibility sample for the 351 Watch agenda crawler: 6 municipalities per state, prioritizing 2025-2026 solar / battery-storage / data-center siting fights found in news, plus a mix of sizes. Populations are approximate.

towns.why_chosen: Planning & Zoning Commission adopted a one-year moratorium on data centers over 5,000 sq ft (2026). Mid-size town (~38k).
Town Council legislative moratorium prohibiting commercial BESS / lithium battery storage facilities. Mid-size town (~28k).
Planning & Zoning Commission memo (Sept 2026) on prohibiting BESS and data centers. Very small town (~1.5k).
Zoning commission discussed a pause on data centers, battery storage and solar; no existing regulations (2026). Small town (~5.5k).
Board of Alders weighed a 12-month data center moratorium (2026). Large city (~135k).
Formed a subcommittee to explore a data center moratorium (July 2026). Mid-size town (~19k).
Residents' group pursuing a Superior Court challenge to 'spot zoning' of industrial solar in residential zones; repeated solar zone-change fights. Small town (~8k).
Zoning changes for what was described as the state's largest solar proposal (article date unclear). Small town (~6.5k).

Residents oppose a solar farm and seek repeal of the Town Council's solar ordinance. Mid-size town (~27k).

Weighed its own data center restrictions (2026). Small town (~2.7k).

State capital; size control (~19k) with no specific fight identified.
